name: JAT Restaurant
why_it_matters: Cited by Tripadvisor reviewers as 'an oasis of North Indian food in Kohima' and 'the first and only place where you can get the naan and tandoori item' — a useful reset for travellers four days into Naga smoked-pork rotation. Ranked #4 of 33 Kohima restaurants. Kitchen claimed and managed by the owner.
insider_tip: Menu is on paper (per Tripadvisor) — staff bring it to the table, no QR codes. The tandoori section is what to order; their dal-and-naan plate fixes any mountain-stomach situation.

name: AMARIS
why_it_matters: One of Kohima's best-rated mid-range restaurants — Tripadvisor 4.5/5, ranked among Nagaland's top 10. Fuses traditional Naga (axone pork, Naga raja mirchi chutney) with Chinese and contemporary plates; ambiance reads casual-sophisticated rather than rustic. The kitchen cooks to order rather than holding pre-cooked food.
insider_tip: Reviews flag long ticket times (often an hour) and items going off the menu at busy hours — go before 7.30pm or after 9pm to avoid the wait. Order the axone pork curry; locals consider it the litmus-test dish for any Kohima multi-cuisine kitchen.
signature_address: Opposite Central Jail, Jail Colony, Kohima 797001

name: Cafe Bela
why_it_matters: Kohima's most-visible pan-Asian outlet — sushi, dim sum, ramen-adjacent noodle bowls in a city where Asian usually means Chinese-Naga fusion. Open 11am-8pm daily. Justdial-rated 3.8/5 across 36 reviews; mixed signal on consistency, strong on the ambition.
insider_tip: Stick to the dim sum and noodle dishes; the sushi is hit-or-miss in a hill town with no daily fish supply. Closes at 8pm — earlier than most Jail Colony spots, so plan dinner before 7pm.
signature_address: Opposite Jail Gate, Jail Colony, Kohima 797001

name: Ooopar
why_it_matters: Billed as 'Kohima's first cocktail dining restaurant' and ranked #2 of 33 Kohima restaurants on Tripadvisor (5.0/5, 9 reviews). Italian-international plates plus modern Naga tasting bites and a proper cocktail list — the city's go-to for date-night and out-of-town business dinners.
insider_tip: Reservations recommended on weekend evenings — the dining room fills fast. Order the pizza (reviewers consistently flag it) and at least one cocktail; the bar is what sets it apart from Kohima's other Italian attempts.
signature_address: 1st Floor, LK Square, Jail Colony, Kohima 797001
